description: This file is a minified/concatenated JavaScript library implementing web components polyfills, URL parsing, mutation observers, and template element support, used as part of the Polymer project's webcomponents-lite.js.

classes.name: HTMLTemplateElement
classes.description: Polyfill for HTMLTemplateElement, enabling template content support in browsers lacking native support.

classes.name: JsMutationObserver
classes.description: Polyfill for MutationObserver, providing DOM mutation observation capabilities.

methods.name: HTMLTemplateElement.decorate
methods.description: Decorates a template element to support content and innerHTML properties.

methods.name: HTMLTemplateElement.bootstrap
methods.description: Initializes all template elements in a document.

methods.name: jURL
methods.description: Custom URL class polyfill implementing URL parsing and serialization.
